Resorts.ParkingAreasDescription:
Choose from free or paid parking lots. No reservations are required for parking.  
Drop off / Pick up locations:  
Winter Park Resort Base 
  1. Level 3 of the Village Parking Garage. Level 3 (top floor), serves as short-term drop skier off. The first 60 minutes are FREE license plate must be entered into ParkMobile or Pay Station regardless if staying for less than 60 minutes or longer.  
  2. Village Cabriolet top terminal in the Vintage Lot. 
  3. The front portion of the North Bench Lot - Closest drop of to Ski and Ride School.  
Mary Jane Base 
  1. Mary Jane bus circle 
Shuttle Information: 
G Lot shuttle operates daily starting on the first day of the season.  
Blue Spruce and Bus Barn aka Old Town shuttle run weekends and holidays only starting mid-December.  
Mary Jane shuttle runs on weekends and holidays.
